# Chapter 4 — 这个工作是他帮我介绍的

**Pinyin:** Zhège gōngzuò shì tā bāng wǒ jièshào de  
**English title:** He recommended me for this job  
**Source:** *HSK Standard Course 2*, printed pages 25–32 (source image pages 045–052).

## New Words

| No. | Chinese | Pinyin | English | Source |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 生日 | shēngrì | n. birthday | p. 26 |
| 2 | 快乐 | kuàilè | adj. happy; glad | p. 26 |
| 3 | 给 | gěi | prep. to; for (used after a verb) | p. 26 |
| 4 | 接 | jiē | v. to receive; to take; to accept | p. 26 |
| 5 | 晚上 | wǎnshang | n. evening; night | p. 26 |
| 6 | 问 | wèn | v. to ask | p. 26 |
| 7 | 非常 | fēicháng | adv. very; extremely | p. 27 |
| 8 | 开始 | kāishǐ | v. to begin; to start | p. 27 |
| 9 | 已经 | yǐjīng | adv. already | p. 27 |
| 10 | 长 | cháng | adj. long | p. 27 |
| 11 | 两 | liǎng | num. two | p. 27 |
| 12 | 帮 | bāng | v. to help; to assist | p. 27 |
| 13 | 介绍 | jièshào | v. to introduce; to recommend | p. 27 |

Names used in examples and practice (not New Words): **大卫** Dàwèi (David), **王方** Wáng Fāng, **马丁** Mǎdīng, **王老师** Wáng lǎoshī (Teacher Wang), and **麦克** Màikè (Mike); pp. 28–30.

## Unique Hanzi in the New Words

Listed once in order of first appearance: **生、日、快、乐、给、接、晚、上、问、非、常、开、始、已、经、长、两、帮、介、绍** (20 characters).

The warm-up on p. 25 also shows **两个儿子、电话、看书、工作、妈妈、医生、朋友**; these are prompts rather than entries in the New Words list.

## Characters

The Characters section on printed pp. 30–31 covers stroke forms, single-component characters, and radicals:

- **Strokes (p. 30):** 竖提 and 竖折折钩. Example characters: **长** cháng (long), **民** mín (people), **马** mǎ (horse), **写** xiě (to write).
- **Single-component characters (p. 31):** **两** liǎng (two), **乐** yuè/lè (music; happy), **长** zhǎng/cháng (old; long).
- **Radicals (p. 31):** **纟** (silk radical; examples **给** gěi, to give, and **结** jié, to tie/knot) and **忄** (standing-heart radical; examples **忙** máng, busy, and **快** kuài, quick/fast).
